findings.F1: Across all coins and profiles, a wide day closing near its low rose the next day by more as its volume grew: wide-range (top tercile) low-quarter closes gave +0.80 % (t 0.73, n 27), +0.59 % (t 1.25, n 218) and +1.50 % (t 2.98, n 454) by volume tercile, and +1.19 % (t 2.84, n 699) together. The extra move did not grow on the second day (+1.24 %, t 2.58), so it is spent in one day.
findings.F2: In a rising, calm market (60-day return above +10 %, 30-day swing at or below the coin's median), down days rebounded the next day by two separate measures. Wide low-quarter closes gave +1.84 % (t 2.55, n 72) and bottom-quintile one-day returns gave +1.11 % (t 2.31, n 198). In falling calm the same cases gave +0.22 % (t 0.26, n 113) and −0.24 % (t −0.45, n 237), and in choppy calm −0.13 % (t −0.16, n 53) and −0.59 % (t −0.79, n 114).
findings.F3: Inside the tested profile, the short on high closes is not graded the way the idea says. By the idea's own score (closeness to the high times range in usual moves), the terciles of the 98 high-quarter closes gave −0.68 % (t −0.61), +0.44 % (t 0.38) and −3.60 % (t −2.22). Closes in the top tenth of the range fell less (−0.70 %, t −0.53, n 29) than those between 0.75 and 0.9 (−1.55 %, t −1.53, n 69), and narrow days did not fall at all (+0.35 %, t 0.30, n 42).
findings.F4: The book's gain rests on a few days. Its daily returns summed to +11.26 % over 1,449 days (mean 0.0078 % a day). Its 5 best days alone summed to +12.53 %, against −6.56 % for its 5 worst. The in-profile fade was negative in 2018 to 2020 (−0.90 %, −2.15 %, −3.53 %) and positive in 2021 (+0.24 %, n 45).
findings.F5: In a rising, calm market, wide high-quarter closes kept rising over the next two days (+1.31 % beyond drift, t 2.57, n 329). This continuation is already held in the map's rising-calm cells (033-03.b2, 034-01.b1, 058-02 range-edge continuation), so it is not a discovery.

ideas.idea: In a rising, calm market, a day closing near its low is followed by a rise over the next day, larger the closer the close sits to the low and the wider the day's range against the coin's 30-day swing of daily returns.
ideas.consequence: A trader in a calm uptrend would buy a wide day that closes near its low for one day, the most after the widest days closing at their lows, instead of reading it as the trend breaking.
ideas.name: rising calm low close rebound

ideas.idea: A wide day closing near its low is followed by a rise over the next day, larger the heavier that day's volume against the coin's 30-day average volume and the wider its range against the coin's 30-day swing of daily returns.
ideas.consequence: A trader would buy a wide low-close day for one day only when it traded heavily, and pass on the same day on light volume.
ideas.name: heavy volume low close rebound
